g.text: Security: a control at every stage, each one real config in this repo
Left to right is the life of a change. Red pill = what makes it fail. Nothing reaches a cluster without passing every column.
Gitleaks: secrets anywhere in the git history
fails when: a secret is found -> PR blocked
fails when: report only -> GitHub Security tab
PR title must be a Conventional Commit
fails when: title does not match -> PR blocked
secrets on the laptop never reach Git
fails when: fixable CRITICAL CVE -> build fails
scan HIGH 0 | tee -a trivy.txt # report only
scan CRITICAL 1 | tee -a trivy.txt # the gate
fails when: no OIDC token -> nothing is pushed
npm removed from the Node runtime image
ArgoCD pulls from Git inside the cluster.
fails when: nothing to steal from CI
least privilege: one repo, demo-* only, 5 kinds
prod needs a human: GitHub Environment
fails when: not approved -> no prod PR
# Required reviewers on this environment pause the run here until someone approves.
CREATE/UPDATE of a Deployment in a protected namespace
fails when: :latest, no memory limit, root, privileged
UPDATE/DELETE by anyone except ArgoCD and kube-system
$ kubectl -n demo-prod set image deploy/orders-api orders-api=nginx:1.29
Manual changes are blocked in GitOps namespaces ...
fixes Rancher/kubectl drift that self-heal misses
value lives in the store, Git has only the key name
fails when: store not ready -> pod waits (never runs without it)
Git: just a name. EKS: AWS Secrets Manager + Pod Identity
